notes.title: 2K Launcher v1.5.3 Release Notes
notes.notes:
We are continuously working to make the experience better: 
 Improved User experience in the Launcher and Error Reporter
 Misc Bug fixes

notes.title: 2K Launcher 1.3.0 Release Notes
notes.notes:
Features

- An Option to check for new 2K Launcher Updates - In the Application Settings, click on "Check for Updates" which will get a new update if available. Please note, the 2K Launcher will need a restart to apply the update.
- 2K Launcher is using the new 2K Logo
- Added trouble-shooting to clear cache by pressing key 'c' during app loading

Bug-Fixes

- Launcher app files are not being extracted to %LocalAppData%\T2GP Launcher
- Fixed Missing 2K icon on the Launcher window fixed in the Alt-Tab overlay and taskbar
- Fixed Incorrect string translations in Error Reporter
- [STEAM only] Game play is now fixed using Steam Streaming mod launch

notes.title: Mafia II: Definitive Edition Patch: June 18, 2020
notes.notes:
Today we released patches for both Mafia II: Definitive Edition and Mafia III: Definitive Edition on PS4, Xbox One, and PC. Below is a list of changes for Mafia II: Definitive Edition on PC. 


Mafia II: Definitive EditionAddressed a reported concern that the 2K Account icon was sometimes getting stuck on the screenAddressed a reported concern that legacy saves were sometimes not working on SteamAddressed reported concerns related to game audioAddressed reported concerns related to refining gameplay

If you're experiencing any issues with either game, please let us know at support.2k.com. Read the complete patch notes for both games at mafiagame.com.
